channel.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
channel.description: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

item.title: Communities along the East Coast recover from Thanksgiving storm
item.description: Storms hit the East Coast hard on Thanksgiving. NPR's A Martinez speaks with Lieutenant Colonel Doug Lemanowicz, New Jersey's Deputy State Director of Emergency Management.
item.content:encoded: Storms hit the East Coast hard on Thanksgiving. NPR's A Martinez speaks with Lieutenant Colonel Doug Lemanowicz, New Jersey's Deputy State Director of Emergency Management.
item.dc:creator: A Martínez

item.title: From Thanksgiving blackouts to Black Friday, a holiday hit by wild weather and economic woes
item.description: A storm battered much of the country on Thursday, knocking out power to thousands of homes and disrupting travel. Today, Black Friday shopping deals kick off, and on Saturday New York City will hold the postponed Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade.

item.title: 12 strategies to cut your risk of dementia. Take this quiz to start
item.description: Here's something you can do as you gather with family and friends this holiday season: Take a free, five-minute quiz to assess your brain health. You'll learn simple changes to keep your mind sharp.

item.title: As UN Secretary General's last day approaches, search for his replacement continues
item.description: The UN Secretary General's term ends this year, but the big powers at the UN have been unable to agree on a replacement. UN watchers worry that there will be little time to get up to speed.

item.title: California voters pass billionaire's measure to bankroll his own medical lab
item.description: California voters passed a ballot measure backed by a billionaire to fund $8.4 billion in immunology research. Half the funding will go to the research group funded by the same billionaire.
